Name: NudeTsMarnie
Author: lychaxo
Description:
The goal of this SMAPI mod is to provide a nude Marnie.  This is a cosmetic mod only.  The nude Marnie also happens to be trans.  The genitalia are visible in some of the sprites.

Currently, only the portraits, beach portraits, main sprites, and beach sprites are updated.  None of the special action/event sprites are updated.

Created and tested only on Linux with Stardew Valley 1.5.1 under Steam.  No guarantees, but since it's just a few .PNG loads via Content Patcher, I can't foresee any risks.

Downloads.Description: Nude Transgender Marnie mod; unzip into your Mods folder and Content Patcher will find it automatically.
